description:
Found through #302's Gate B spike. When an extern's contract application is Underconstrained the extern returns none and its native body lowers to 'trap user1'; the program dies with an illegal instruction (lldb: udf #0xc11f) in compiler2_jit_preserves_range_reduce3_halt_and_suspend_from_native_artifacts under that spike. No current program reaches it on develop, but the failure mode is a signal instead of a diagnostic.

Wanted: a compile-time error naming the extern and the unresolved contract. First step is a reproducer on develop without the spike (the spike that reached it: scratch gh302b/spike-1-env-toggled-sites.patch, Gate B only; dbg(t) :: t with t bound to a tuple holding a closure).
title: An extern whose contract publishes no result is a loud error, not a trap body
